title: Network and Server Order Cancellation Fee After the Purchase Order
content:
## Fee clause

The infrastructure cancellation fee, charged when a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order is cancelled after its purchase order was placed and before it shipped, is the order type's after-purchase-order cancellation fee percentage of the order's quote total: 15 percent for a Network Equipment Order and 25 percent for a Server & Storage Build Order, the figures shown for them in the cancellation terms.

The fee percentage is applied to the quote total, and the fee so built never exceeds the deposit paid on the order, the sum of the payments on its ledger counted up to the deposit invoiced.

The infrastructure cancellation fee is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Quote total and units ordered | the cancelled order's own record |
| Payments and deposit invoiced | the cancelled order's own billing ledger |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Order type | Quote total | Deposit invoiced | Payments on the ledger | Deposit paid | Percentage amount | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Equipment Order | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 1500.00 | 1500.00 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 20000.00 | 10000.00 | 10400.00 | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Network Equipment Order | 10000.00 | 5000.00 | 1200.00 | 1200.00 | 1500.00 | 1200.00 |

In the second case the payments of 10400.00 are counted only up to the 10000.00 invoiced as deposit. In the third the built fee of 1500.00 is held at the 1200.00 of deposit paid.
